supersedes: 器件级针网候选.svg and 器件级针网与每车净增.json REJECTED because direct UCC GUARD bypass applied to legacy requests
concept: Independent comparator directly sinks DUMP_OFF_HW; separate optical request and GUARD channels form series AND. UCC VDD and enable derive from independently supplied supervised domain. Existing GUARD outputs and original DUMP_OFF network remain intact except UCC pin5 moved.

supervisors.U_R: REF_2V5 -> 51.1k -> SENSE -> 10k -> GND; nominal release 2.444 V
supervisors.outputs: both OUT -> HW_READY, pullup 47k to 12V_HW, 1M and 100nF to GND, 100nF bypass each VDD
supervisors.caveat: thresholds nominal only; monitor is undervoltage only, no guaranteed settled reference, UCC start sequencing or default-off proof

legacy_gated_isolation.output: DUMP_OFF_HW -> U_REQ pin4; pin3 -> U_GUARD pin4; pin3 -> GND_SYS
legacy_gated_isolation.caveat: confirm GPIO/guard output load and VO617A CTR at actual low LED current, temperature and lifetime; leakage, saturation, optocoupler short and startup are not qualified

independent_comparator: TLV1811, REF5025, Rhigh=143k+600R, Rlow=10k, Rfeedback=6.8M; CMP_OUT through 22k to BC847C pin1 B, 100k B to GND; pin2 E to GND and pin3 C to DUMP_OFF_HW. Q_HW is Nexperia BC847C, source FOC Q_BUCK_RELEASE BOM C9900010419. Thresholds and circuit remain unverified.
foc_each: BC847C C -> BUCK_CLAMP_BASE, E -> GND_SYS, B -> GPIO_UNASSIGNED through 4.7k and 100k to GND, no electrical connection to LPV; evaluate collector clamp current and firmware safety

vehicle_delta.note: Count excludes unselected input protection and additional qualified supervision; original R_QP_COL remains unchanged. No current component prices established.

open_items: Module exact manufacturer and pinout, input fuse, reverse polarity, hot plug, short and surge protection
REF overvoltage monitoring and startup settling; common-cause faults; comparator unpowered output; reliable UCC default-off and release timing
Legacy GUARD output can drive optocoupler LED safely; all operating conditions and faults, LED aging, CTR, isolation and timing
UCC pin 5 and pin 6 timing and full threshold tolerances; false dump and loss of dump failure modes
FOC control/hold implementation and real braking torque
0.5ms actual current establishment including 100uH wiring, switch SOA, 0.82ohm repetitive heat, bus peak and stop distance
Native design, DRC, pin-net readback and physical verification are not completed
q_hw_static_screen: At 13.2 V pullup / 47k gives 0.281 mA plus UCC IN- current and optical leakage; base current approx (VOH - VBE)/22k minus VBE/100k, actual worst case not proved. Check gain, saturation, input current and VIL over temperature and comparator output swing.
rejected_prior_gate: Prior AO3400A gate with 1k/100k at 13.2V can reach ~13.07V and exceed UMW AO3400A abs VGS ±12V; rejected.
